checks.title: Dependency manifest without a lockfile
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Every dependency manifest has a committed lockfile so builds are reproducible.
checks.remediation: Commit package-lock.json / yarn.lock / pnpm-lock.yaml / Pipfile.lock / poetry.lock and install with the frozen-lockfile option in CI.

checks.title: Floating or unpinned dependency specifications
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Dependencies use bounded versions; Python requirements are pinned with ==.
checks.remediation: Replace *, latest, open ranges and branch refs with exact or bounded versions and pin requirements (preferably with hashes).

checks.title: npm install lifecycle scripts present
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Packages do not run code automatically at install time.
checks.remediation: Remove preinstall/install/postinstall hooks or move the work to explicit build steps; install with --ignore-scripts where possible.

checks.title: GitHub Actions not pinned to a commit SHA
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Third-party actions are pinned to full-length commit SHAs.
checks.remediation: Pin each uses: reference to the 40-character commit SHA (with a version comment) and let Dependabot/Renovate update it.

checks.title: GitHub workflow privilege and injection risks
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Workflows run least-privilege tokens, never check out untrusted PR code under pull_request_target and never interpolate event data into scripts.
checks.remediation: Declare permissions: contents: read, avoid head checkout in pull_request_target, and pass event values via env: variables instead of ${{ }} in run:.

checks.title: Hardcoded secrets in the repository
checks.expected_secure_behavior: No credentials or private keys are committed; secrets are injected at runtime from a secret store.
checks.remediation: Rotate the exposed secret, remove it from history, and load it from environment variables or a secrets manager; add secret scanning to CI.

checks.title: Dependencies fetched from VCS, URLs or plain HTTP
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Dependencies come from the trusted registry with integrity hashes, not directly from VCS or arbitrary URLs.
checks.remediation: Publish internal packages to a private registry, pin by version and hash, and never resolve over http://.

checks.title: Known-vulnerable dependencies (OSV)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: No dependency version in the lockfiles matches a published advisory.
checks.remediation: Run osv-scanner against lockfiles, upgrade or patch vulnerable packages and gate CI on new findings.
